A field guide to an inhabited world · volume XII · the shell and tentacle family

Mollusks

Five soft-bodied monster girls: the kraken, the squid girl Ika, the clever octopus, the timid snail and the ammonite in her coiled shell. Tentacles, ink and shells: each has her own way of staying safe.

Favourite food: Fish (a snail prefers vegetables)

The central similarity

Soft inside, clever outside.

Mollusks have no bones to protect them, so every one of them has a trick: tentacles, ink, a shell to hide in, or simply being too big to bother.

  • TentaclesThe kraken grabs and holds; Ika lashes with her hair from four blocks away.
  • InkThe octopus and Ika squirt ink at attackers (blindness) and slip away.
  • ShellsThe snail and the ammonite pull into their shells and take hardly any damage.
  • FishThe family food. The snail would rather have vegetables.

Relationships (shared by every family)

The same relationship core runs through all MonsterGirls families, from the harpies on. This volume only changes how a mollusk builds trust, what she gives back, and how she bears young.

AffectionEach monster girl remembers every player separately. Feeding, petting and her family's own bond action raise it; hurting her lowers it. /monstergirls bonds lists everyone nearby.
SitRight-click any monster girl with a plain stick to make her sit; again to let her get up.
Sharing a bedAt high friendship (25) she may join you in bed: once a night she decides, one in three at 25, certain at 100. Sleep through the night and she is expecting.
ExpectingA pregnancy lasts one in-game day. Her belly rounds out as it goes on (the model shows it).
Born devotedHer young are born devoted to the player who fathered them (full affection) and never share that player's bed.
PresentsAt high friendship every family brings presents of its own kind.
BondAffectionWhat it means
Wild0Keeps her distance; her species' instincts decide everything.
Curious3+Lets you come close and watches what you do.
Fond10+Follows you a little way, accepts petting, stops fleeing.
High friendship25+May join you in bed at night (one night in three, more the fonder she is) and brings presents.
Devoted60+The family's devoted perk unlocks (see each guide).
Full devotion100The most there is. Every daughter feels this for the player who fathered her.

Friendship

What builds trust

  • Fish (any), kelp
  • Vegetables for the snail (carrots, potatoes, beetroot)
  • Petting when she is not frightened

What costs trust

  • Frightening her (sprinting at her)
  • Hitting her

Devoted (60+)

She shares her ocean: Water Breathing near her in water, and gifts of prismarine, ink and nautilus shells.

Mating & young

FormA clutch of eggs. Young2-4 young, grown in 5 days. WhereIn water (the snail: on land). Young use the adult model at 45%.

1. CourtshipAt high friendship she may share your bed (the kraken and the ammonite only beside water).
2. EggsMollusks lay clutches of eggs: in water for the sea dwellers, under leaves for the snail.
3. HatchingTwo to four young hatch after a day.
4. GrownYoung grow up in five days, devoted to their father.

Behaviour & gameplay (shared by the family)

Tentacle gripThe kraken's grab holds a target in place (Slowness IV) while she squeezes.
InkWhen hurt, the octopus and Ika squirt ink: Blindness on the attacker, and they dash away.
RetreatThe snail and the ammonite pull into their shells when threatened: 80% less damage, but they cannot move.
Clever handsThe octopus opens doors, trapdoors and gates, and picks up anything interesting.
Slime trailThe snail leaves a faint trail that slows mobs following her (a short-lived trail of particles).

Species profiles

Deep oceanHuge · possessive

Kraken (about 2.6 blocks)

TemperamentGrand, possessive, dramatic

Ecology & behaviourA sea witch with eight tentacles for a lower body. She drags boats and swimmers about for fun.

Signature: GripHer grab holds a target in place while she squeezes. A wild kraken attacks swimmers in the deep until she is fed fish.

Player interactionBring her fish; let her hold you (she does not squeeze friends).

Ika (about 1.6 blocks)

TemperamentMischievous, proud, easily flustered

Ecology & behaviourA squid girl with a squid hat and ten tentacles for hair, who has come ashore to conquer the land (and keeps getting distracted).

Octopus (about 1.65 blocks)

TemperamentClever, curious, skittish

Ecology & behaviourThe cleverest of them all. Opens anything with a handle, collects shiny things and flees from trouble in a cloud of ink.

Ammonite (about 1.7 blocks)

TemperamentOld-fashioned, shy, wise

Ecology & behaviourHer torso rises out of a great coiled shell. A living fossil, she remembers the seas before.

Signature: RetractThreatened, she pulls her whole body into her shell (80% less damage). She gives fossils (bones, nautilus shells) as presents.

In the game

Built (2026-10-19)

  • Kraken: grip (Slowness IV), attacks swimmers in the deep until fed
  • Ika: hair lash reaches three extra blocks, ink
  • Octopus: opens doors, skittish, inks (Blindness) her attacker
  • Snail: vegetables only, retreats into her shell (a fifth of the damage), slime trail slows monsters
  • Ammonite: retracts into her coiled shell
  • Sea dwellers swim and are slow on land
  • Eggs: roe in water, a clutch on land for the snail
  • Devoted: Water Breathing while you swim near her
  • Squidkin: when her friend is hurt near her she squirts ink; the monsters around go blind and her friend turns invisible for a moment
  • Jellyfish: glows at night, stings whatever bumps into her (Poison), friends swimming near her get Night Vision

Not yet

  • The kraken pulling a boat

Design decisions log

Decided (2026-10-19)

  • The snail is the exception to the family food: vegetables, not fish.

Open questions

  • Should the kraken be able to pull a boat (a ride)?
